name: interface-layer
description: InterfaceLayer: Jared Parmenter's Claude Code plugins, each pinned to a release commit in its own repo.

plugins.name: omnilog
plugins.description: Append-only action log for Claude Code: hooks write one ASCII line to .claude/.omnilog/.omnilog.md per tool call, per response (with real token cost), and per subagent finish.

plugins.name: truename
plugins.description: Finds the right name for an artificial entity (company, repo, plugin, variable, skill trigger) by deliberately indirect, multi-lens generation, then scores and availability-checks the finalists.
